claims: The San Francisco Giants play an exhibition game against the Sultanes de Monterrey on Monday, March 23, 2026, at 6:45 p.m. PT at Oracle Park, San Francisco.
The game will be broadcast on NBC Sports Bay Area.
The game will be available on radio via KNBR.
The game will be available on radio via KSFN.
The San Francisco Giants play another game against the Sultanes de Monterrey on Tuesday at 6:45 p.m. PT.
The San Francisco Giants have their Opening Day against the Yankees on Wednesday.
